records.text: Donald Trump said Jessica Tarlov makes up poll numbers and is bad for the country.
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

appearances.snippet: I am watching one of the least attractive and talented people on all of television, Jessica Tarlov. Her voice is so grating and terrible I had to turn her off. ... Her Democrat soundbites are fake. She makes up poll numbers. Poll numbers and nobody challenges her because she's so boring. ... Get her off air. She's bad for our country.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous coverage reproduces Trump Truth Social post accusing Tarlov of making up poll numbers and calling her bad for the country.

sources.title: Trump Melts Down at Least Attractive Democratic Female TV Star
